h1: The 5 Best Computer Monitor Privacy Screens of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Monitor Privacy Screens: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 5 best computer monitor privacy screens, all sized for 24 inch 16:9 displays, compared on pack size, attachment and price.
summary: The Peslv 2-pack is the best computer monitor privacy screen for dual desks, with two removable 24 inch filters in one box. The magnetic 2-pack is the pick for fast on and off, and the IPROKKO covers two screens at a lower price. SightPro is the single filter for one monitor.
intro: Ordering a privacy filter by the word monitor is how most returns happen. A filter is cut to a diagonal and a ratio, and a 16:9 sheet laid over a different ratio leaves a bare strip along one edge or sticks out past the bezel. The product page title rarely warns you, so the mismatch only shows up when the box is open.

Every filter in this ranking is listed for a 24 inch, 16:9 monitor, the one size we could confirm across the whole pool. We ranked five on pack size, attachment style and price bucket, using only what the listings state. Brightness loss and viewing angle are not in our data, so we make no claims about them. Pull up your monitor's model number before you click anything.

products.name: Peslv [2-Pack] 24 Inch Privacy Screen for Computer Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Two removable filters cover a dual-monitor desk in one purchase.
products.description:
The Peslv is a 2-pack of removable privacy screens for 24 inch, 16:9 monitors, priced between $50 and $100. Two filters in one box cover a second monitor without a second order, and the removable design means each sheet lifts off for the moments you want others to see your screen. Buying a pair also means both panels get matching treatment.

The top spot goes to it because removability and a paired purchase beat the alternatives for a dual desk. It costs more than the cheaper 2-packs, and it states no more about attachment than the others do.

Best for dual-monitor desks. The caveat is fit: it only suits 24 inch, 16:9 screens, so a 27 inch or 16:10 panel needs something else. A one-monitor desk would waste the second sheet.

products.name: 2 Pack 24 Inch Magnetic Computer Privacy Screen for Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Magnetic attachment for fast on and off.
products.description:
This 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 screens attaches magnetically, in the $50 to $100 bucket. Magnets let a filter come off in a second when someone needs to see your display, then return without adhesive or fiddly clips. For a person who flips between private work and shared review, that speed is the whole selling point.

Second place suits it because the Peslv offers a removable pair at the same price, and this listing says no more about film or fit. The tradeoff is price, which matches the leader. Magnetic mounting also depends on the monitor's design: some bezels leave nothing for the magnets to hold.

Best for people who switch between private and shared use. Check your bezel before ordering, and confirm what the magnets grip on, because the listing does not explain it.
products.idealFor: Users who often share their screen.
products.skipIf: You never need to remove the filter.

products.name: IPROKKO [2-Pack] 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Widescreen Monitor
products.verdict: A 2-pack that lists multi-brand compatibility for less.
products.description:
The IPROKKO is a 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 widescreen privacy filters, listed as compatible with multiple monitor brands, in the $25 to $50 bucket. Multi-brand compatibility is useful when your office has Dell on one desk and Acer on the next: the same sheet can serve both.

Third place reflects the lower price and the stated compatibility, though it lacks the magnet convenience of the second pick, and the listing does not name an attachment method. A compatibility claim is a promise from the seller, not a guarantee, so measure before you trust it.

Best for cost-conscious dual-monitor users who rarely remove the filter. The caveat is that you should still confirm your exact monitor size and bezel, because 24 inch covers several panel shapes.

products.name: Magicmoon 2-Pack 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Monitor
products.verdict: A plain 2-pack in the lower price bracket.
products.description:
The Magicmoon is a 2-pack of 24 inch, 16:9 privacy screen filters, priced in the $25 to $50 bucket. It gives you two sheets for the budget band at about the same cost as the IPROKKO.

It ranks fourth because the listing offers fewer extras than the IPROKKO. No compatibility claim is made, no attachment style is stated, and nothing beyond size and pack count appears. When two products share a price, the one that tells you more earns the better rank.

Best for buyers who want two filters without paying a premium. The caveat is the thin listing. Read the product page and any owner questions for mounting details, and check your monitor's size and ratio carefully, because no other compatibility help is offered.

products.name: SightPro 24 Inch 16:9 Computer Privacy Screen Filter for Monitor
products.verdict: One 24 inch filter for a single-monitor desk.
products.description:
SightPro is a single 24 inch, 16:9 privacy screen filter, in the $25 to $50 bucket. One sheet for one screen is the right purchase when you only own a single monitor, and there is no spare sheet to store.

It ranks last only because the other four give you two filters for a similar price band. For a solo screen, though, it makes sense, and it keeps cost at the low end. Listing detail is brief, with no attachment method or compatibility note.

Best for a solo screen. The caveat is that a second monitor needs a second purchase, which would cost more than a 2-pack. Check how it mounts before ordering, as the listing is silent, and measure your bezel.

whatMatters.detail: A filter must match your panel's diagonal and its ratio. A 16:9 filter on a different ratio leaves gaps along an edge. Check your monitor's specs against the listing in detail, and treat 24 inch as a necessary condition, not a sufficient one. Look up the resolution if you are unsure, and check whether the stand is attached to the bezel.

A 2-pack covers two monitors, and a single covers one. Buying the wrong count wastes money or leaves a screen exposed. Check the pack quantity in the title, as on the Peslv and magnetic pack, and match it to the number of screens in your workspace before you pay, including a laptop display you might want covered.

Filters attach with adhesive strips, clips or magnets. Magnets and removable designs let you take the filter off. Look for the attachment type in the listing, as the magnetic pack and Peslv state it, and note that the IPROKKO, Magicmoon and SightPro do not, so ask before buying if quick removal matters.

Some listings state multi-brand compatibility, as the IPROKKO does. That is helpful but not a guarantee. Always confirm exact dimensions and bezel width in millimeters, and read the product questions for owners with your monitor model before trusting a broad claim, since a vague list of brands may not include your model.

2-packs span from $25 to $50 up to $50 to $100. Higher prices often add convenience, such as removable or magnetic mounting. Check the current price on the day you buy and weigh it against how often you will take the filter off, because a cheap fixed filter gets annoying quickly if you present often or need color-accurate work.

faq.a: No. Each is listed for a 24 inch, 16:9 monitor, so measure your screen first. A 27 inch or 16:10 panel needs a different filter, and the sellers here do not offer one, so search again with your exact size.
Ordering by the word monitor without checking size and aspect ratio. A mismatch leaves gaps or an overhang, and the filter cannot be trimmed to fit, which makes the return a nuisance.

faq.q: Is the Peslv worth it over the IPROKKO?
faq.a: If you want a removable design, yes. Otherwise the IPROKKO covers two screens for less, in the $25 to $50 bucket, though it does not state an attachment method.

Follow each listing's method. Magnetic and removable designs avoid permanent fitting, so the Peslv and the magnetic pack can come off. Clean the bezel first for a better hold, and press along each edge to seat the filter evenly.

faq.q: Do privacy filters dim my screen?
faq.a: Filters generally darken the view slightly. Check listing details before buying, because our data does not cover brightness loss, and look at owner reports for the specific pack, since dimming varies between films.

faq.q: Can I use a 2-pack on one monitor?
faq.a: Yes, but you would waste the second filter. A single like the SightPro costs less and avoids the extra sheet. Keep a spare if you plan to add a monitor later, but do not buy a pair just in case.

finalTake: Buy the Peslv for two matching 24 inch, 16:9 monitors, or the magnetic pack if you share your screen often. The IPROKKO and Magicmoon suit tight budgets, and SightPro suits a single monitor. Confirm your size and ratio before you order, because none of these fits another shape.
